summary: World War II stealth real-time tactics series from Pyro Studios, later revived by Kalypso/Claymore with HD remasters and Commandos: Origins.

entries.title: Commandos: Behind Enemy Lines

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the PC release.

primary.why: Behind Enemy Lines is a Windows PC tactics game, and the modern PC release is the complete and most practical capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version through a modern PC storefront and apply compatibility fixes if the original executable needs them.

entries.remaster_caveats: No HD remaster for the first game; use compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.title: Commandos: Beyond the Call of Duty

emulation.notes: No emulation needed, but legacy compatibility fixes may be useful.

primary.why: Beyond the Call of Duty is a stand-alone Windows expansion with no alternate official platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release after Behind Enemy Lines if following the series chronologically.

entries.title: Commandos 2: Men of Courage
entries.definitive_edition: Commandos 2 - HD Remaster on Windows for modern play; original Windows release for preservation comparison

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for HD Remaster; original console versions are archival-only.

primary.why: The Windows HD Remaster has the highest resolution presentation, reworked controls/UI/tutorial, and the easiest capture path; the original PC version remains relevant for purists who want the untouched 2001 presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Play Commandos 2 - HD Remaster on Windows for the modern route; use the original Windows release only if the archive goal is original-presentation comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The HD Remaster modernizes visuals/UI/controls and is not a bit-perfect preservation of the 2001 release.

entries.title: Commandos 3: Destination Berlin
entries.definitive_edition: Commandos 3 - HD Remaster on Windows for modern play; original Windows release for preservation comparison

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for HD Remaster.

primary.why: The Windows HD Remaster has native widescreen support and the highest-fidelity modern presentation, while the original Windows/Mac releases remain preservation alternatives.
primary.how_to_play: Play Commandos 3 - HD Remaster on Windows for a modern archive route; use the original Windows version only for original-presentation comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD Remaster changes presentation and UI; not a bit-perfect original.

entries.title: Commandos: Strike Force

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity version of the FPS spin-off; PS2 and Xbox versions have no documented exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version if covering the shooter spin-off; keep it clearly separate from the real-time tactics entries.

entries.remaster_caveats: Genre shift to first-person shooter; no remaster.

entries.title: Commandos: Origins
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Shadows over Crete content

primary.version: Windows PC release with Shadows over Crete content
primary.why: Windows has the highest-fidelity and most capture-friendly version, Game Pass/PC storefront support, and the same documented content as the console versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version and include the Shadows over Crete campaign/content if doing a complete post-launch run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern prequel rather than a remake; keep separate from the HD remasters.
